payload.title: Lead README with Highlights + two-option Install; make init --install turnkey
payload.body: Reorder the README to best-practice (uv/bun) order — Highlights, then Installation with exactly two paths (copy-this-prompt / single command), then a format teaser — and close the install gap so the single command is genuinely turnkey: tasks init now CREATES AGENTS.md (with the Task Management section) when missing, so npx @tasks-md/cli init --install works on a bare repo with no 'touch AGENTS.md' prereq. Files: packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts, init.test.ts, README.md, docs/user-stories/10-one-prompt-setup.md (anchor + prompt sync).
